header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH, CIRCUIT COURT, MIRPURKHAS
(Muhammad Waseem v/s. Province of Sindh & Ors)
Petitioner: Through Mr. Farhan Ahmed Bozdar Advocate
body: 1. Through instant Petition, the Petitioner has claimed appointment against deceased quota available under Rule 11 - A of the Sindh Civil Servants (Appointment, Promotion & Transfer) Rule, 1974 (APT Rules).

2. It is the case of the Petitioner that his father was employed in School Education Department Government of Sindh and died while in service on 11.08.2016. Petitioner at the time of death of his father was minor, however on attaining majority, he approached the Respondents to consider his case for appointment but to no avail. Learned Counsel therefore prays for appropriate directions.

3. Learned Additional Advocate General, admits the claim of petitioners however states that Petitioner was required to approach the department within two years time from the death of his father, but he applied late, therefore cannot be considered for appointment. He therefore prayed for dismissal of the petition.

4. It reflected from the record that Petitioner’s father Shah Muhammad Mangrio was PST in School Education Department Government of Sindh and he passed away in year 2016 and at the time of the death of his Father Petitioner’s aged was 13 years. He attained majority on 06.02.2022, and applied for the job within one year time, as such his request was found within time and endorsed by the District Education Officer & Director Schools Education in their office letters dated 10.03.2023 and 08.02.2023 respectively (page 41 - 45 of the petition), as such objection raised latter on is not sustainable under the law.

5. It further transpired from record that Government of Sindh has constituted a committee to consider the cases of children of deceased employees in terms of Rule 11-A of APT Rules. In view of above, this petition is disposed of. The Respondents are directed to place the case of Petitioner before the departmental scrutiny committee and decide the same within a period of 3 months’ time from date of this order.
6. Office is directed to send copy of this Order to the Respondents for compliance.
